main.description: The name of the main entry-point file.

additionalEntryPoints.description: An array of paths corresponding to the additional entrypoints of application. One bundle will be generated for each entrypoint.

rootDir.description: The root directory of the project.

outputPath.description: The output path of the generated files.

outputFileName.description: The path to the main file relative to the outputPath

tsConfig.description: The path to the Typescript configuration file.

config.description: Config file to load bun from (e.g. -c bunfig.toml

smol.description: In memory-constrained environments, use the smol flag to reduce memory usage at a cost to performance.

bun.description: Force a script or package to use Bun.js instead of Node.js (via symlinking node)

target.description: The intended execution environment for the bundle.

format.description: Specifies the module format to be used in the generated bundles.

env.description: Controls how environment variables are handled during bundling.

sourcemap.description: Specifies the type of sourcemap to generate.

external.description: A list of import paths to consider external.

packages.description: Control whatever package dependencies are included to bundle or not.

publicPath.description: A prefix to be appended to any import paths in bundled code.

define.description: A map of global identifiers to be replaced at build time. Keys of this object are identifier names, and values are JSON strings that will be inlined.

loader.description: A map of file extensions to built-in loader names. This can be used to quickly customize how certain files are loaded.

banner.description: A banner to be added to the final bundle, this can be a directive like "use client" for react or a comment block such as a license for the code.

footer.description: A footer to be added to the final bundle, this can be something like a comment block for a license or just a fun easter egg.

drop.description: Remove function calls from a bundle. For example, "console" will remove all calls to console.log.

generateLockfile.description: Generate a lockfile (e.g. package-lock.json) that matches the workspace lockfile to ensure package versions match. Ignored when `generatePackageJson` is set to `false`.

generatePackageJson.description: Generate package.json file in the output folder.

cwd.description: Current working directory of the command.
